verdict.summary: Interfacing remains on a seeded snapshot because the assessment runner is in dry-run mode.
strengths: This component is wired into the atlas assessment registry.
risks: Dry-run mode does not perform a live AI verdict.
Repository scan depth is limited to deterministic probes until OPENAI_API_KEY is provided.
Deterministic probes currently report fail status.
next_actions: Enable responses mode with OPENAI_API_KEY for live verdict generation.
Expand repository registry coverage and local_path mappings for additional components.
